metadata.summary: A large dataset of 377,110 chest x-rays associated with 227,827 imaging studies sourced from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2011–2016; images are de-identified and labeled with 14 conditions derived via NLP from free-text radiology reports.
metadata.purpose: To provide a convenient processed version of MIMIC-CXR and a standard reference for data splits and image labels, facilitating research in medical computer vision.

papers.title: MIMIC-CXR-JPG, a large publicly available database of labeled chest radiographs

ethics.privacy_measures: All images have been de-identified to protect patient privacy.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with U.S. HIPAA regulations; de-identification performed per Safe Harbor method.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。

known_limitations: Labels derived from NLP of radiology reports, not expert review — may contain inaccuracies or omissions.
Single-center origin limits generalizability across institutions, devices, and populations.
No demographic statistics reported (age, sex, ethnicity), limiting bias analysis.
Temporal range (2011–2016) may not reflect current imaging practices or disease prevalence.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — JPEG conversion and NLP-derived labeling applied to original DICOMs from MIMIC-CXR.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ single-center (BIDMC, Boston, USA); no demographic breakdown provided.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability beyond similar academic U.S. hospital settings and time period (2011–2016).
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage information reported (e.g., age, sex, race, socioeconomic status).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Label incompleteness due to NLP failure on ambiguous or unstructured report text; no quantification provided.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Derived entirely from the MIMIC-CXR database, which contains chest radiographs collected during routine clinical care.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected 2011–2016; no explicit statement of temporal shifts, but device/software changes over this 5-year span may introduce distributional shifts.

population.target_population: Adult patients undergoing chest radiography in clinical care at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.
population.inclusion_criteria: Chest radiographs performed at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center with associated free-text radiology reports.

attribute_recording.unknown_proportion: Unknown proportion of missing or ambiguous labels due to NLP extraction limitations; no quantification provided in source text.
attribute_recording.recoding_modifications: Labels derived via two NLP tools applied to free-text radiology reports; no further recoding details provided.

annotation.annotation_method: Two natural language processing tools applied to free-text radiology reports to derive 14 labels.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from free-text radiology reports via NLP; presence of label noise implied but not quantified.
annotation.label_noise_description: Labels are derived from NLP of free-text reports and thus subject to extraction errors, ambiguity, and incompleteness.
